manifest.name: dsh-logo-ui
manifest.description: Custom logos and typography controls for DeepSeek Harness, with local image processing and bilingual settings.

bundle.text:
# DSH Logo UI: brand logo override + sidebar typography hierarchy.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-logo-ui
      name: "dsh-logo-ui"

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) · **简体中文**

为 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 添加自定义 Logo 与界面字号设置。支持本地图片处理和中英文设置界面。

“十二楼 / TWELVE”是本次效果演示使用的 Logo；插件名称为 **DSH Logo UI**，可上传自己的图案。

[中文设置](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/settings-zh.jpg) · [English settings](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/settings-en.jpg) · [左下角小标](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/twelve-white-footer.png) · [全部截图与拍摄说明](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/README.md)

- **Logo 工作室**：上传 PNG / JPG / WebP / SVG，按背景色容差去背景、裁剪透明边距，支持纯色、渐变、跟随主题和自定义颜色。
- **尺寸与布局**：调整 Logo 大小和展开态对齐；折叠侧栏复用图标，支持空会话首屏 Logo 与可选底部水印。
- **字号层级**：全局正文字号 8–32px 可调，侧栏主要文字保持 `max(10px, 正文字号 − 4px)`；支持快捷键和跟随 DSH 外观设置。
- **中英文**：自动跟随系统，或固定为中文 / English；设置支持导出、导入和恢复默认。

图片在当前浏览器本地处理，不上传图片。插件没有额外运行时依赖，使用 DSH 提供的客户端接口。

正式版本：**1.0.0** · [GitHub Release 安装包](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

本项目通过公开 GitHub 仓库与 Release 分发，不发布到 npm。

在 DSH 的插件管理页选择添加插件，使用：

```text
github:dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui#v1.0.0
```

Web profile 也可以使用 CLI：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui#v1.0.0'
```

桌面端请优先使用应用内插件管理；CLI 使用者应确认自己操作的是当前应用使用的 profile。安装后重启对应服务或完全退出再打开桌面应用。

从 [v1.0.0 Release](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/releases/tag/v1.0.0) 下载 `dsh-logo-ui-1.0.0.tgz` 及 `.sha256`，校验后安装，无需私有 registry 或 GitHub Packages 凭据。

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c dsh-logo-ui-1.0.0.tgz.sha256
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-logo-ui-1.0.0.tgz
```

[完整安装、更新与卸载说明](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/INSTALL.md)

打开 **设置 → DSH Logo UI**。选择 Logo、调色、大小与位置，或切换语言。字号快捷键：

- `⌘/Ctrl + Shift + =`：放大；
- `⌘/Ctrl + Shift + -`：缩小；
- `⌘/Ctrl + Shift + 0`：恢复跟随 DSH 字号。

独立安装及功能验收环境为 **macOS + DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的 Web 界面**；桌面端首页另有真实截图；Windows、Linux 和其他 DSH 版本仍需验证。部分字号及布局规则依赖 DSH 内部 DOM/class，升级 DSH 后请复查。

设置页内容会即时切换语言。Logo 去背景采用颜色容差处理，不是人像或复杂场景的 AI 分割。

- [问题反馈](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/issues) · [版本记录](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) · [贡献指南](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- 维护者：[dan-cube](https://github.com/dan-cube)
- 独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无关联。

**English** · [简体中文](README.md)

Custom logos and typography controls for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**, with local image processing and bilingual settings.
“Twelve / 十二楼” is the logo used in this demonstration. The plugin is named **DSH Logo UI** and accepts your own artwork.

[中文设置](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/settings-zh.jpg) · [English settings](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/settings-en.jpg) · [Sidebar watermark](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/twelve-white-footer.png) · [All screenshots and capture notes](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/screenshots/README.md)

- **Logo studio:** upload PNG / JPG / WebP / SVG, remove a background by color tolerance, trim transparent margins, and choose solid colors, gradients, theme colors or a custom color.
- **Size and placement:** adjust the expanded logo size and alignment, reuse the mark in the collapsed sidebar, and control the empty-conversation logo and optional footer watermark.
- **Typography:** adjust the global body font from 8–32px; main sidebar labels follow `max(10px, body size − 4px)`. Includes shortcuts and a mode that follows DSH appearance settings.
- **Languages:** follow the system language or select 中文 / English. Export, import and reset settings.
Images are processed locally in the browser and are not uploaded. The plugin uses DSH client interfaces and adds no runtime dependencies.

Stable version: **1.0.0** · [GitHub Release tarball](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

Distributed through the public GitHub repository and Release assets. No npm registry publication.

In DSH plugin management, add this source:

```text
github:dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui#v1.0.0
```

For the Web profile, you can also use:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui#v1.0.0'
```

For Desktop, prefer the in-app plugin manager. CLI users should confirm the profile used by their running application. Restart the corresponding service, or fully quit and reopen Desktop after installation.

Download `dsh-logo-ui-1.0.0.tgz` and its `.sha256` file from the [v1.0.0 Release](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/releases/tag/v1.0.0), verify the checksum, then install. No private registry or GitHub Packages credentials are required.

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c dsh-logo-ui-1.0.0.tgz.sha256
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-logo-ui-1.0.0.tgz
```

[Installation, updates and uninstalling](https://github.com/dan-cube/dsh-logo-ui/blob/v1.0.0/docs/INSTALL.md)

Independent installation and functional checks used **macOS + the DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 Web interface**. The Desktop home screen was also captured directly. Windows, Linux and other DSH versions need verification. Some typography and layout rules depend on internal DSH DOM/class names; recheck after DSH updates.

Settings content changes language immediately. Background removal uses color tolerance, rather than AI segmentation of people or complex scenes.
